metadata.title: Clicked like I forgot the game was on and somehow nabbed 1 clueless soul?! Valorant logic again
metadata.description:
Me: panic-clicking like my mouse is a potato
Enemy: probably quitting out of sheer confusion
How did that even count? No clue but I’ll take the freebie
If you’ve ever won by accident, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim’s a beautiful disaster too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
